name: dropzone_arcade
provenance: Schema-fill (Step 3) output captured verbatim from a live `unity-create` run. Never hand-edited; see tests/fixtures/README.md.
notes: VerticalCorridor descent, 2000 m. The shape hand-written fixtures never reproduced: generic `kind` with the meaning carried in `tag`, and a player group the fill tagged Player on a kind=prop entity. This is the case that exposed the avatar spawning at the world origin while the layout placed it at the corridor top. FLOOR MOVED 98->96 when the custom_script_body check landed: CameraManager and ParachuteSystem carry no body, so each is a component attached to a live object that does nothing. The build did not get worse — a real defect that nothing measured before is now counted. Re-lock upward once Step 3.5a (unity_micro_code.enrich_scripts) authors them. entity_scene_coverage added to ungraded_ok (score unchanged): this fixture declares no scene_specs, so every scene hosts every entity and nothing can be orphaned — the new check (added after 8 of Grandma's Antique Shop's 14 named entities turned out to be named by NO scene_spec and so never spawned anywhere) has nothing to grade here.
